name: Box Breathing (4-4-4)
benefit: Reduces stress, improves focus and mental clarity
description: Used by military personnel and athletes to calm the mind and boost performance.

name: Relaxing Breath (4-7-8)
benefit: Better sleep, less anxiety, and calm
description: Popularized by Dr. Andrew Weil; activates the parasympathetic nervous system.

name: Equal Breathing (5-5)
description: Simple and effective; an easy balancing breath technique for daily life.

name: Deep Breathing (6-2-8)
description: Delivers more oxygen to the body and helps raise your energy level.

name: Triangle Breathing (3-3-3)
benefit: Less anxiety, panic management, and quick calm
description: Ideal for calming down quickly; effective during anxiety or panic moments.

name: Extended Exhale (4-4-6)
benefit: Stress relief, heart-rate regulation, and relaxation
description: Strengthens the parasympathetic nervous system through a longer exhale.
